scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic 16-real-equation elimination, analytical coefficient positivity and two endpoint balances; independently cross-checked with a complete four-spin Lindblad solution at finite parameter samples. Finite numerical checks are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four sites, uniform local dephasing, equal Markovian reservoir couplings and linear tilt; classifies only the derivative at zero dephasing, not global extrema or noisy-measurement detectability. Unindexed stronger exact finite-chain classifications could affect publication originality.
title: A sharp four-site weak-dephasing threshold with reentrant contact dependence
